name: Welcome To... Chichester 3: Plenty Of Time To Live
source:
The final episode in the trilogy, this takes place on the last day of the protagonist's holiday, which has quickly changed from being enjoyable to extremely dangerous as the protagonist and his friends find themselves being targetted by a re-activated covert assassination squad.

Will the protagonist and Grendel be able to return to America in more or less one piece ?
